content:
The image shows a single leaf with:
- Irregular pale/whitish-gray patches scattered across the upper leaf surface
- Patches have a powdery or dusty appearance, blending into the green tissue
- No necrotic lesions with dark margins (rules out Anthracnose)
- No black sooty coating covering the surface (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No tip/branch dieback visible (rules out Die_Back)
- The diffuse, whitish, powdery-looking spots distributed across the lamina are characteristic of fungal surface growth typical of Powdery Mildew
